source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently randomized complex reference-based photographic test of portcullis and gatehouse architectural legibility; randomized choices are agent interpretation, not requester definitions.
subject: Adult woman textile conservator with visible appearance informed by attached portrait
setting: Medieval stone gatehouse with a half-lowered iron portcullis
event: Conservator pauses carrying rolled linen banner before entrance, looking at ironwork
visual_priorities: Half-lowered portcullis grating and stone guide grooves remain clearly readable
Two towers, central passage and connecting chamber form a legible gatehouse
Reference-derived visible facial features and dark wavy hair remain recognizable
baseline_prompt_en: A photorealistic location editorial of an adult woman working as a textile conservator carrying a rolled linen banner toward a medieval stone gatehouse in late afternoon during thinning mist. Use the attached portrait as a visible appearance reference for her long dark wavy hair, brown eyes, softly oval face, and natural lip shape. She wears a charcoal wool coat and practical leather boots, her hands supporting the fabric roll at waist height, paused three steps before the entrance while looking up at the ironwork. A heavy iron portcullis is suspended halfway down inside the entrance arch, its intersecting vertical and horizontal bars and pointed lower teeth clearly visible. The grille's two side edges sit in continuous vertical stone grooves, and the open space beneath its teeth reveals the receding vaulted passage. The gatehouse consists of two substantial stone towers flanking this single central passage, joined by a masonry chamber above the arch. Show the tower bases, entrance and upper connecting chamber together so the gatehouse reads as one defensible building. The woman stands beside the opening rather than overlapping the grille. Wet paving catches pale sky reflections, and a small warm lamp deep in the tunnel gives the entrance a readable depth. Frame a vertical environmental portrait from a slightly oblique viewpoint, with the woman in the lower left and the entire central entrance visible. Keep the portcullis bar pattern, stone grooves, flanking towers and the reference-based face legible within one natural photographic exposure.
